cohort_total_n_excerpt: There were 399 incident cases of prostate cancer, 476 population controls and 621 cancer controls.
reason: The study analyzes incident prostate cancer overall using population and cancer control groups; the abstract does not report an aggressive incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Among daily tea drinkers, the odds ratio associated with the highest tertile of cumulative consumption was 2.0 (95% confidence interval (CI) 1.3-3.0) when using population controls and 1.6 (95% CI 1.0-2.4) when using cancer controls.
estimate_classifications.reason: The tea estimate is for incident prostate cancer overall, not an aggressive subtype.
